messages.author: 88efd60c3c258703
messages.subject: nls models and confidence bands
parts:
Hi all!

I just found out how AMAZINGLY easy it is to create a composite plot
nicely arranged and even with a wonderful nonlinear curve fit (http://
www.ualberta.ca/~sschreib/). However, I would like to add confidence
bands to my regression lines, although plotting this on top might get
a bit noisy then ... any thoughts on that?

Here is my code:

p<-ggplot(dat, aes(temp, leak))
p+geom_point() + geom_smooth(aes(colour = date, group = clone), method
= 'nls', formula = y~a/x+b, se = F, start = list(a = 400,b = 80)) +
facet_grid(mygroups ~ date)

I assume I can use stat_function(), or geom_curve() to add the CI
bands. My question though is how can I extract the standard errors for
intercept and slope for the nls model calculated by geom_smooth().

Thanks all!
Stefan

Too bad ...
 
I actually did save the nls outputs (intercept, slope, se etc) in lists for all my subsets using for loops. I also plotted everything with the base plots in R including the confidence bands. However, this script is terribly long and involes a lot of steps. When I saw how easy, short and good looking it is with ggplot2, I was blown away. Anyway, I will dig a little bit deeper and see how can feed my output list into stat_function(), or geom_curve().
 
Thanks though!
 
Stefan
